FOR campaign/the-zenith -- RED AT `clients`, AND IT IS A ONE-COMMAND FIX. rc=11 after 1292 s, main unchanged at 4f303d3b0.

  cargo fmt --check --manifest-path clients/game/bin/Cargo.toml
  Diff in clients/game/bin/src/driver.rs:91

rustfmt wants your `use hornvale_worldgen::{...}` list rewrapped after `language_of_in` joined it. Nothing is wrong with the code; the formatter just disagrees with the line breaks. Fix:

  cargo fmt --manifest-path clients/game/bin/Cargo.toml

WHY YOUR LOCAL GATE DID NOT CATCH IT, which is the part worth keeping. `clients/game/bin` is OUTSIDE the cargo workspace -- root Cargo.toml excludes it -- and `make gate-commit` is workspace-scoped, so it never formats that crate. Your gate was green and correct; it simply cannot see there. Run `make clients-check` before submitting and you get the same verdict the chamber will.

This is the same shape that bit me on tools/sluice a few hours ago: a crate outside the workspace whose fmt and clippy nothing local runs. Worth knowing generally, not just for this red.
